name: 소서러
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one full-body fantasy tower character, square transparent game asset.
REFERENCE IMAGE is the user-approved BOW atlas. It is the exact STYLE authority ONLY. Match its CLEAN 2D CARTOON / ANIME GAME rendering: economical tapered outlines, large clear local-color shapes, restrained 2-3-tone cel shadows, organized hair/fur/feather masses and simple material highlights. Clean appealing anime faces. No painterly gacha splash finish, realism, 3D, scratched metal/leather microtexture, intricate embroidery, ornate gold filigree, dense runes, countless hair strands, busy small armor plates or airbrush haze.
Design the requested original character; do not copy an archer, bow, or any existing commercial character. For adult human subjects use natural approx 6.5-7.5-head anatomy and readable long limbs, NOT SD/chibi. Nonhuman anatomy follows its species. Expressive distinct face/body/pose/camera for each subject; comfortable anatomically connected upright neck, no head cocked sideways. Exactly the limbs required by the described species, correct connected hands and weapon grips.
Composition: square image, ONE entire character with specified essential tools/companions, all head/ears/hair/wings/tail/feet and weapon tips visible with at least 45px clear padding on every side. Fill the square generously with the COMPLETE silhouette, never crop equipment or soles. TRUE transparent alpha PNG. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, pedestal, labels, text, numbers, grid, border, watermark or unrelated decorative particles. Integral elemental bodies/flames/wings and specified equipment allowed; no surrounding explosion or background glow. Must read as a distinct game silhouette at 96 pixels.

Subject: An adult HUMAN FEMALE ice SORCERER archmage with long dark blue hair in a low loose braid, clear blue eyes, cool composed mature face. Navy and glacier-blue layered robe with a broad white fur collar, plain silver clasp and practical boots. Upright side three-quarter stance, one arm extends a simple long ice-crystal-tipped staff, other holds a CLOSED small pale spellbook against waist. Large crisp robe folds and a few simple clear ice facets. Human natural skin, no giant glowing circle, no snowstorm, no numerous floating shards, no ice-body transformation.
